e74e8161ea95f0c6.description: Job description Remote Automation Support Specialist (RASS) Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Department: Remote Automation Support Reporting to: Remote Automation Support Manager Help Customers Stay Connected, Productive, and Operational Are you passionate about technology, problem solving, and delivering outstanding customer support? We are looking for a Remote Automation Support Specialist (RASS) to join our growing team in Riyadh and play a key role in supporting customers and distributors across the region. This position is ideal for a technically minded professional who enjoys diagnosing issues, providing remote support, and working directly with customers to keep critical automation systems operating at their best. You'll be the first point of contact for technical enquiries, ensuring issues are resolved efficiently while consistently meeting customer service and SLA commitments. What You'll Be Doing As a Remote Automation Support Specialist, you will: Provide first-line technical support to customers and distributors across the region. Respond to support requests via ticketing systems, email, and telephone. Investigate customer enquiries and recommend effective solutions and best practices. Gather and analyse technical information required for troubleshooting and issue resolution. Diagnose hardware, software, network, and automation-related issues remotely. Resolve incidents where possible or escalate complex issues to higher support levels when required. Coordinate with third-party service providers and internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues. Track, manage, and communicate progress throughout the support lifecycle. Maintain accurate documentation, records, and closure notes for all support activities. Monitor service performance against key support metrics including response times, remote fix rates, first-time resolution, and SLA compliance. Manage and follow up on warranty claims, ensuring timely communication between customers and manufacturing partners. Produce regular status reports on warranty claims and support activities. Contribute to the continuous improvement of support processes, knowledge sharing, and customer experience initiatives. Support additional departmental projects and initiatives as assigned by the Remote Automation Support Manager. What We're Looking ForEssential Qualifications Degree, diploma, or certification in Engineering or a related technical discipline, including: Electrical Engineering Mechatronics Engineering Mechanical Engineering Software Engineering Computer Engineering Information Technology IT Infrastructure Experience working with technical support, automation systems, hardware, software, or related technology environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues remotely. Excellent customer service orientation and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced support environment. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Preferred Experience Up to 3 years' experience within a Software, Hardware, Help Desk, Technical Support, or Automation Support environment. Experience supporting customers in production, industrial, or operational technology environments. Knowledge of support ticketing systems, remote diagnostic tools, and service management processes. Experience working with third-party service providers and external partners. Proven ability to deliver support services against defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Language Requirements To effectively support a diverse customer base, candidates should possess: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English . Fluency in Arabic . French language skills would be highly advantageous. What Success Looks Like You will excel in this role if you: Enjoy solving technical challenges and helping customers succeed. Communicate clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Take ownership of issues through to resolution. Thrive in a customer-focused environment where responsiveness and quality matter. Are proactive, organised, and committed to continuous learning. Work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team. Why Join Us? This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a team supporting advanced automation technologies across the region. You'll work with a diverse customer base, develop your technical expertise, and make a direct impact on customer satisfaction and operational performance. If you're passionate about technology, customer success, and delivering world-class remote support, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help keep our customers running at their best. WHO IS GILBARCO VEEDER-ROOT Gilbarco Veeder-Root, a Vontier company, is the worldwide technology leader for retail and commercial fueling operations, offering the broadest range of integrated solutions from the forecourt to the convenience store and head office. For over 150 years, Gilbarco has earned the trust of its customers by providing long-term partnership, uncompromising support, and proven reliability. Major product lines include fuel dispensers, tank gauges and fleet management systems. WHO IS VONTIER Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies. Our smart, connected solutions serve roadside convenience retail stores, fleet operators, and auto repair technicians. From integrated payments and EV charging software to carwash technology and retail automation, we help customers stay productive and prepared for a rapidly evolving industry. With decades of expertise and a balanced portfolio, Vontier enables businesses to navigate complexity, unlock growth, and build a cleaner, safer future. Driven by continuous improvement and the dedication of Team Vontier, we empower businesses to think bigger, act boldly, and thrive on the road ahead. Learn more at www.vontier.com At Vontier, we empower you to steer your career in the direction of success with a dynamic, innovative, and inclusive environment. Our commitment to personal growth, work-life balance, and collaboration fuels a culture where your contributions drive meaningful change. We provide the roadmap for continuous learning, allowing creativity to flourish and ideas to accelerate into impactful solutions that contribute to a sustainable future. Join our community of passionate people working together to navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. At Vontier, you are not on this journey alone, we are committed to equipping you with the tools and support you need to fuel your innovation, lead with impact, and thrive both personally and professionally. Together, let’s power the way the world moves! Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

e7a1a3fb3c9a3928.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن فني ميكانيكي محركات للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الباحة. يركز هذا الدور على متابعة تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية، وتحديد القطع التبديلية، وفحص وتشخيص الأعطال، بالإضافة إلى متابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة عمليات تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إجراءات تشغيلها الأولية. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة للمحركات، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المحركات الميكانيكية المخصصة للخدمة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص أعطال المحركات الميكانيكية بدقة، ومتابعة جميع مراحل إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع المهام. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا المحركات. معرفة قوية بتركيب المحركات الميكانيكية وتشخيص أعطالها. القدرة على تحديد القطع التبديلية ومطابقة مواصفاتها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الباحة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، مع التركيز على تطبيق أفضل الممارسات في صيانة وإصلاح المحركات الميكانيكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

e7f354d0a1c3acae.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البناء الشامل للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، إعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بشكل دقيق. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، مع توضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على فهم وتحليل المخططات والتصاميم الهندسية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في التحليل والتصميم الإنشائي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات الإشراف والمتابعة الميدانية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق هندسي متخصص في بيئة داعمة تتيح لك تطوير مهاراتك المهنية. تقديم الطلبات نحن ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة البناء الشامل للاستشارات الهندسية.

e7b4f0fd6d6395d7.description: The Director, Geospatial Governance is accountable for the strategic leadership, governance, management, and continual improvement of QIC’s enterprise geospatial capability. The role leads the GIS team and serves as the business owner for the Esri Enterprise platform, including the Enterprise Geodatabase (SDE), ArcGIS Enterprise environment, geospatial services, standards, and governance frameworks. The position ensures that geospatial information is managed as a trusted enterprise asset, supporting planning, design, development, construction, operations, asset management, and digital twin initiatives. The Director establishes and maintains geospatial governance, data stewardship, quality assurance, platform performance, security, and compliance while driving innovation and business value through geospatial technologies. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership · Develop and execute the enterprise geospatial strategy and roadmap. · Align GIS initiatives with corporate objectives, digital transformation programs, and business priorities. · Promote geospatial information as a strategic enterprise asset. · Lead the adoption of emerging geospatial technologies, automation, analytics, and digital twin capabilities. · Provide executive-level advice on geospatial data, systems, and governance. Geospatial Governance · Establish and maintain enterprise GIS governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures. · Define authoritative geospatial datasets and manage their lifecycle. · Lead enterprise data stewardship and accountability frameworks. · Establish decision rights for geospatial information management. · Chair GIS governance and technical review forums. · Ensure compliance with enterprise data management and information governance policies. · Oversee schema governance and change control processes. Enterprise GIS Platform Ownership · Serve as the business owner for the Esri Enterprise environment. · Lead governance and oversight of ArcGIS Enterprise, Portal for ArcGIS, ArcGIS Server, and Enterprise Geodatabases (SDE). · Establish standards for service publishing, deployment, security, and lifecycle management. · Oversee platform availability, performance, scalability, resilience, and disaster recovery. · Lead upgrade planning, release management, and platform modernization initiatives. · Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and infrastructure standards. Enterprise Geodatabase (SDE) Governance · Govern the design, structure, and management of enterprise geodatabases. · Establish standards for branch versioning, data editing, reconciliation, and data publishing workflows. · Oversee database architecture, performance optimization, and operational health. · Approve enterprise schema modifications and geodatabase design changes. · Ensure long-term integrity, consistency, and sustainability of enterprise geospatial data assets. Data Quality and Assurance · Define enterprise GIS quality management frameworks. · Establish validation rules, quality controls, and acceptance criteria. · Oversee geospatial QA/QC activities across projects and business units. · Implement auditing, monitoring, and reporting mechanisms. · Drive continual improvement in data quality, completeness, and accuracy. · Ensure all submissions into the enterprise environment meet approved standards. Digital Delivery and Project Assurance · Define digital geospatial deliverable requirements for projects and programs. · Support project stage-gate reviews and technical assurance processes. · Review and approve geospatial submissions from consultants, contractors, and project teams. · Ensure compliance with GIS standards, contracts, and information management requirements. · Act as the escalation point for geospatial compliance and delivery issues. Enterprise Integration and Interoperability · Lead integration of GIS with BIM, CAD, Civil 3D, asset management systems, digital twins, and enterprise platforms. · Establish interoperability standards and data exchange processes. · Govern geospatial APIs, web services, and integration patterns. · Support enterprise-wide information management initiatives. Team Leadership and Capability Development · Lead and develop a high-performing GIS team. · Establish workforce plans and capability development programs. · Provide mentoring, coaching, and professional development opportunities. · Manage recruitment, succession planning, and performance management activities. · Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. · Manage specialist consultants, vendors, and service providers. Stakeholder Engagement · Build strong relationships across business units, projects, and executive leadership teams. · Represent geospatial interests in enterprise governance forums. · Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to define information requirements. · Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and executive stakeholders. Essential · Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geomatics, Surveying, Geography, Information Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. · Minimum 10-15 years' experience in GIS, geospatial information management, or enterprise spatial systems. · Minimum 5-10 years' experience in leadership and people management roles. · Demonstrated experience managing enterprise GIS environments and large-scale geospatial programs. Desirable · Master's degree in GIS, Geomatics, Information Management, Data Management, Engineering, or Business Administration. · Esri Technical Certification. · Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent). · Data Governance or Information Management certifications.

e771f1cfd70d5750.description: About the Role State Street is seeking an Assistant Vice President (AVP) for Core Operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading end-to-end post-trade custody operations, including clearing & settlement, cash & FX operational support, corporate actions/income, reconciliations, and client onboarding/account set-up. The position operates Sunday to Thursday and requires over 10 years of experience. Role Context and Importance This role is critical for enabling scalable market entry and growth by delivering strong, controlled post-trade operations aligned with local market infrastructure and rules. It ensures a high-quality client experience through timely settlement, robust exception management, and strong controls as market activity expands in Saudi Arabia. The AVP will support State Street's ability to deepen relationships with key institutional clients as the market evolves, contributing to the firm's growth strategy in the priority market of Saudi Arabia, supported by Vision 2030 reforms. e7daf3de777c2082.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فرع شركة سوسيداد ايبيريكا دي كونستركشنز الكتريكاس سوسيداد ا عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، مع التركيز على ضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه عمليات تقدير الموازنات وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وبتكلفة تقديرية. تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع المشاريع والبرامج الأخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم مدى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها إلى الأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لعمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع والبرامج. القدرة على مراقبة سير العمل وتتبع الموازنات والإجراءات التعاقدية. مهارات ممتازة في تحديد التكاليف ومصادر التمويل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتضمن بيئة العمل الإشراف على فرق متعددة والتنسيق مع مختلف الأطراف المعنية لضمان نجاح المشاريع. ملخص الدور يتطلب هذا الدور مديراً لإدارة المشاريع يتمتع بخبرة قوية في الإشراف على دورات حياة المشاريع الكاملة، بدءاً من التخطيط ووصولاً إلى الإغلاق، مع التركيز على تحقيق الأهداف الاستراتيجية للشركة.

e7243f9842df59f6.job_title: Rigger - Turbine Outages & Precision Equipment Handler (Saudi Arabia)
e7243f9842df59f6.description: Job Description The Turbine & Precision Equipment Rigger is responsible for executing highly critical, heavy, and precision lifting operations during power plant turbine outages and industrial maintenance shutdowns. This role demands exceptional technical expertise to safely handle multi-million dollar rotating equipment, gas/steam turbine components, and delicate machinery within tightly restricted spaces. The successful candidate must strictly adhere to engineered lifting plans, maintain zero-compromise safety standards, and display flawless precision under fast-paced outage timelines. Key Responsibilities Rigging Execution: Safely attach, lift, guide, and position heavy turbine components and associated mechanical equipment in strict compliance with approved, engineered lifting plans . Pre-Lift Assessment: Thoroughly review critical technical parameters prior to every lift, including total load weight, exact center of gravity , designated lifting points, travel path clearances, and final landing arrangements. Equipment Management: Select, calculate, and inspect specialized rigging hardware such as synthetic/wire-rope slings, shackles, spreader beams , chain blocks, and specialized lifting accessories. Compliance & Safety Verification: Audit all lifting tackle before use to verify valid identification tags, current inspection status, and Working Load Limits (WLL) . Precision Maneuvering: Expertly guide immense structural loads through highly restricted areas and congested plant environments utilizing controlled mechanical methods and precise signaling. Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5 years of proven experience as an industrial rigger, with a strong preference for candidates who have completed major turbine outages, power plant shutdowns, or heavy mechanical maintenance . Technical Skills: Comprehensive knowledge of rigging mathematics, center-of-gravity calculations, crane signals, and rigging hardware capacities. Certifications: Valid third-party rigging certifications (such as TUV, Bureau Veritas, Aramco, or equivalents ) are highly preferred. Physical Capability: Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and handle the physical demands of 12-hour shifts typical during emergency or scheduled outages. Soft Skills: Strong teamwork orientation, high attention to detail, and a strict commitment to safety protocols.

e7929a4a292b6fd2.description: Job Purpose: The SMS Manager is responsible for leading, governing, and continuously improving Tibah Airports' Safety Management System in accordance with applicable GACA regulations, ICAO requirements, company policies, and recognized aviation safety practices. The SMS Manager leads the implementation of the four SMS pillars, oversees safety assurance and performance, manages the SMS team and associated resources, and provides management with reliable safety information to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement. Job Responsibilities: Lead the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the organization's Safety Management System. Establish and maintain SMS policies, procedures, manuals, standards, and governance frameworks in alignment with GACA regulations, ICAO requirements, and company policies. Translate organizational safety objectives into departmental plans, priorities, initiatives, and measurable performance targets. Ensure effective implementation and integration of the four SMS pillars: Safety Policy & Objectives, Safety Risk Management, Safety Assurance, and Safety Promotion. Periodically review the effectiveness and maturity of the SMS and recommend improvements to senior management. Lead the organization's hazard identification and safety risk management processes. Ensure appropriate methodologies are applied for risk identification, assessment, mitigation, acceptance, and escalation. Oversee the organizational safety risk register and ensure identified risks, mitigations, responsible parties, and target dates are appropriately maintained. Review and challenge significant safety risk assessments and ensure appropriate controls are established before risk acceptance. Ensure safety risks arising from operational, organizational, procedural, infrastructure, or system changes are properly assessed through the Management of Change process. Escalate significant or unacceptable safety risks to the appropriate management level.
